alt: Interior of the new Highmark Stadium showing upper-level seating with glass safety railings partially blocking the sightline to the field below
story: Buffalo's new $2.2B Highmark Stadium opened in August 2026 with glass safety railings that obstruct at least three rows of 400-level seats, and when fans complained the architect explained the blockage was an intentional consequence of concourse design decisions.
why_funny: Paying hundreds of dollars for an NFL seat only to be told the railing blocking your view was deliberately put there is architectural gaslighting at stadium scale.
